For the Petitioner : M/s. Jitendra Shankar Singh, Advocate For the State : M/s. Praful Jojo, A.P.P.
-----
02/09.12.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Chhipadohar P.S. Case No. 10 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 439/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 304B, 498A,
34 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.

3. The petitioner happens to be the sister-in-law of the deceased who died in her matrimonial home,
due to asphyxia because of hanging within seven years of her marriage.
It is alleged that she was tortured to enforce the demand of dowry.
4. It was submitted that there is general and omnibus allegation against the accused persons.
It was further submitted that the petitioner is a lady.
It was finally submitted that deceased had committed suicide due to family dispute.
5. Mr. Praful Jojo, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail, but does not dispute the aforesaid Kalawati Devi @ Sunaina Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Latehar in connection with Chhipadohar P.S. Case No. 10 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 439/2024.
